name: Claude Haiku 5.5
note_long: The weakest Claude. The hats drift toward cowboy and sun hats, the board sits in the water in two runs, and run 1 lifts the whole foil out of the sea.

note.en: Cowboy hats, sunken boards, a wing lifted out of the sea.
note.ru: Ковбойские шляпы, утонувшие доски, крыло над водой.
